name: breakeven_decomposition_and_failure_synthesis
description: Explain the break-even result instead of only reporting it, and join the cost evidence to the reproducibility evidence so the price of keeping every published figure can be read in one place.

decomposition.method: ordinary least squares over the six frozen sweep sizes, one line per treatment and per measure
decomposition.not_claimed: these are descriptions of six measured points, not fitted models with inference; no confidence interval is computed and none may be quoted

projection.never: a projected crossing may never be reported as a break-even point, and may never enter the break-even table or the answer to P3

breakeven.condition_reporting: for every comparison, say which quantity would have to change for a crossing to become possible, and say plainly that the change was not tested

synthesis.question: what does it cost to keep every published figure reproducible
synthesis.joins: recall and failures from H13C, time and bytes from H11, read sizes from H14, real-release cost from H12
synthesis.recall_source_is_authoritative: recall figures are copied from the H13C audit, never recomputed here

invariants: the measured break-even table is carried forward unchanged
every projection is labelled as outside the measured range and is kept out of the break-even table
recall and failure counts are copied from H13C without recomputation
a treatment reported with full recall must show no material failure
every reported slope names the six sweep sizes it was computed over
